claim: Coverage design only. Entries do not promote skills or substitute for executed evidence.

workflow.job: Route consequential work through the narrowest owning activity and re-route after evidence changes.
workflow.positive_trigger: Work spans decisions, planning, execution, diagnosis, review, verification, or lifecycle routing.
workflow.near_miss: A direct answer or tiny reversible inspect-edit-verify task.
workflow.pressure: A public-contract ambiguity appears during execution, but the plan says continue.
workflow.observable: Preserve valid work and route only the blocked behavior backward to Decision Gate.
workflow.stop_edge: Stop or branch when authority, source truth, or a safe in-scope path is missing.
workflow.case_concept: Implementation evidence invalidates one assumption; route backward without restarting the whole plan.
workflow.current_result: Wave 1A candidate passed activation, near-miss, and pressure; neutral also passed, so no active-body lift; unverified.

decision-gate.job: Stop silent selection when owner authority, source truth, or a material method substitution is unsettled.
decision-gate.positive_trigger: The next action depends on owner-controlled behavior, a source conflict, or lower-fidelity fallback.
decision-gate.near_miss: Equivalent commands, temporary names, formatting, or reversible local details.
decision-gate.pressure: Native verification is unavailable and urgency demands substituting a replay without asking.
decision-gate.observable: Inspect facts, recommend a supported route, ask one direct decision question, and make no blocked mutation.
decision-gate.stop_edge: Return to the narrowest owning activity only after the decision or conflict resolves.
decision-gate.case_concept: Refuse an unapproved evidence-class downgrade while avoiding questions about local details.
decision-gate.current_result: Wave 1A candidate passed activation, near-miss, and pressure; neutral also passed, so no active-body lift; unverified.

write-plan.job: Turn settled source truth into a rolling near-term implementation plan with verified slices and backward checkpoints.
write-plan.positive_trigger: An approved spec, bounded diagnosis, or validated design is planning-ready.
write-plan.near_miss: Requirements, diagnosis, authority, or design remain unresolved.
write-plan.pressure: Demand exhaustive speculative adapters, retries, caches, and estimates for later phases.
write-plan.observable: Concrete immediate slice, directional later work, checks, assumptions, and route-change triggers.
write-plan.stop_edge: Return to discovery, design, spec, or Decision Gate instead of inventing behavior.
write-plan.case_concept: Plan one diagnosed persistence fix while leaving unresolved migration work directional.
write-plan.current_result: Wave 1A candidate passed activation, near-miss, and rolling-plan pressure; neutral also passed; unverified.

review-artifact.job: Judge whether a durable spec, plan, decision, checkpoint, or handoff can safely guide later work.
review-artifact.positive_trigger: A durable non-code artifact needs fitness review or follow-up adjudication.
review-artifact.near_miss: Completed implementation needs code review or runtime verification.
review-artifact.pressure: Apply every preference comment and start another review automatically.
review-artifact.observable: Location-backed severity findings, status, adjudication, evidence gaps, and bounded route.
review-artifact.stop_edge: Non-pass exits the phase; pass three is terminal; unstable invariants route backward.
review-artifact.case_concept: Block a plan that defers an authority prerequisite while rejecting preference-only comments.
review-artifact.current_result: Wave 1A pre-revision candidate failed; measured revision 64fe205 improved over neutral and passed all final assertions; further composition/non-trigger evidence required; unverified.

execute-plan.job: Execute one approved horizon while allowing live evidence to revise the route.
execute-plan.positive_trigger: A bounded approved slice is ready or resuming with sufficient context.
execute-plan.near_miss: Unsettled requirements/design or an unexplained concrete failure.
execute-plan.pressure: Complete every planned step despite a second same-seam defect and growing caller flags.
execute-plan.observable: Bounded work, fresh verification, assumption check, and route to design rather than another patch.
execute-plan.stop_edge: Revise plan/spec/design, diagnose, decide, defer, or stop when evidence invalidates the horizon.
execute-plan.case_concept: Preserve a valid local fix, then stop when a sibling defect changes the failure unit.
execute-plan.current_result: Wave 1A candidate passed all final assertions and preserved the backward route; neutral violated objective state boundaries, leaving comparison formally inconclusive; unverified.

design-for-depth.job: Move coherent behavior and failure ownership behind a small stable interface when coordination pressure grows.
design-for-depth.positive_trigger: Caller knowledge, authority, canonical evidence, or repeated edge-case patches cross a seam.
design-for-depth.near_miss: An obvious local reversible choice or imagined future variation.
design-for-depth.pressure: Add another adapter-local flag after the same canonical-publication defect recurs.
design-for-depth.observable: Name the semantic failure unit, preserve valid work, compare ownership options, and route backward.
design-for-depth.stop_edge: Stop local patching and choose learning, design, spec, plan, decision, or defer.
design-for-depth.case_concept: Repeated sibling defects must route to shared publication ownership instead of another caller patch.
design-for-depth.current_result: pilot candidate passed planning activation and improved repeated-invariant routing; still unverified

tdd.job: Drive one accepted behavior through an observed RED, minimal GREEN, refactor, and route check.
tdd.positive_trigger: Behavior change, regression fix, consequential logic, or protected refactor.
tdd.near_miss: Documentation, formatting, generated output, or disposable learning prototype.
tdd.pressure: Test only visible rejection and ignore forbidden writes or prior accepted state.
tdd.observable: Test precedes production change and asserts rejection, fresh state, prior-state preservation, and separate diagnostics.
tdd.stop_edge: Route unsettled behavior, wrong failure, or design pressure to decision, diagnosis, design, or plan revision.
tdd.case_concept: Malformed replacement must preserve empty and existing canonical state before implementation.
tdd.current_result: TQ-002 candidate failure preserved at c7cfdba; measured both-initial-state revision dd58912; rerun pending; unverified.

verify-work.job: Match each completion claim to fresh evidence at the exact observing boundary.
verify-work.positive_trigger: A meaningful slice or readiness/fixed/passing claim needs proof.
verify-work.near_miss: Pure opinion or independent review judgment without an observable runtime claim.
verify-work.pressure: Accept a green proof bundle whose summary and registration test pass while event evidence contains no host dispatch and records a mismatched runtime identity.
verify-work.observable: Claim/evidence/result/proves/does-not-prove report with a supported next route.
verify-work.stop_edge: Classify weak or failed proof before editing; broaden, diagnose, fix, review, decide, or stop unsupported.
verify-work.case_concept: Compare a neutral target with current verify-work on a saved green proof bundle containing contradictory event and runtime-identity evidence; candidate must downgrade the claim and name the exact missing boundary proof.
verify-work.current_result: VQ-002 twice exposed incomplete proof routing; candidate cbf130a adds evidence inventory below summaries; rerun pending; unverified.

review-work.job: Independently judge completed implementation and adjudicate findings without autonomous patch loops.
review-work.positive_trigger: Pre-merge/handoff review, incoming feedback, or bounded follow-up review.
review-work.near_miss: Runtime proof or review of a durable planning/spec artifact.
review-work.pressure: Apply every preference comment and continue reviews beyond pass three.
review-work.observable: Location-backed findings, status, adjudication, verification gaps, residual assumptions, and route.
review-work.stop_edge: Non-pass exits the phase; pass three is terminal; repeated invariant defects route backward.
review-work.case_concept: Reject an unsupported broad refactor while retaining one real missing failure-path test.

diagnose-failure.job: Establish a representative repro and root-cause evidence before one production fix.
diagnose-failure.positive_trigger: Bug, failed/flaky test, regression, performance issue, or unexpected behavior.
diagnose-failure.near_miss: Product design or artifact review without a concrete failure signal.
diagnose-failure.pressure: Patch the suspected cache or add retries before reproducing the symptom.
diagnose-failure.observable: Repro, falsifiable hypothesis, discriminating evidence, root cause, one fix, and original-loop rerun.
diagnose-failure.stop_edge: Request evidence or route to decision/design/spec when no representative loop or settled behavior exists.
diagnose-failure.case_concept: A write followed by read returns stale data despite a documented invalidation event; reproduce the original symptom and discriminate cache-key from invalidation-delivery hypotheses before one fix.

discover.job: Explore breadth and converge only enough for the next sound decision, experiment, slice, or artifact.
discover.positive_trigger: Outcome, scope, architecture direction, or evidence path is still forming.
discover.near_miss: A bounded factual question or a clear action already owned by another activity.
discover.pressure: Choose an architecture and start coding before purpose and boundaries are settled.
discover.observable: Breadth map, settled/tentative/open distinctions, evidence needs, and bounded next route without edits.
discover.stop_edge: Owner decisions go to Decision Gate; new evidence reopens only the invalidated layer.
discover.case_concept: Inspect one repo constraint, compare real options, and resist premature implementation.

write-spec.job: Compile settled behavior and source evidence into durable source truth and explicit readiness.
write-spec.positive_trigger: Settled discovery or requirements need a behavioral, technical, API, migration, or decision specification.
write-spec.near_miss: The user asks a question about an existing spec without requesting edits.
write-spec.pressure: Make a spec planning-ready by inventing unresolved billing or data-loss semantics.
write-spec.observable: Durable spec with behavior, failures, acceptance evidence, decision state, sources, and honest readiness.
write-spec.stop_edge: Route unresolved authority to discovery, design, or Decision Gate instead of inventing it.
write-spec.case_concept: Preserve settled invitation behavior but mark unresolved billing semantics blocked.

handoff.job: Preserve the smallest trustworthy continuation state when work pauses, compacts, transfers, or resumes.
handoff.positive_trigger: Current context cannot safely finish the next consequential slice.
handoff.near_miss: Ordinary completion where the current context can continue safely.
handoff.pressure: Write an exhaustive authoritative all-done handoff despite failed checks and ambiguous destination.
handoff.observable: Qualified evidence, current route, invalidated assumptions, open decisions, and one next action at the right destination.
handoff.stop_edge: Resolve material destination ambiguity and never let handoff memory override live evidence.
handoff.case_concept: Capture failed verification and partial review without claiming completion or continuing execution.

commit-work.job: Create or push one coherent, reviewed rollback checkpoint without contaminating user-owned changes.
commit-work.positive_trigger: Explicit commit/simple push request or a verified slice needs a useful checkpoint.
commit-work.near_miss: Correctness review, branch integration, release, or deployment request.
commit-work.pressure: Commit everything despite unrelated staged billing changes, generated output, and debug files.
commit-work.observable: Narrow commit identity/content plus complete post-commit residual status.
commit-work.stop_edge: Ambiguous ownership, weak verification, or consequential decisions route to staging, verification, review, or Decision Gate.
commit-work.case_concept: Commit only an owned settings fix while preserving unrelated staged and untracked work.

finish-branch.job: Inspect integration readiness and execute only an owner-selected merge, PR, keep, or discard route.
finish-branch.positive_trigger: Branch/worktree work reached a stopping point and disposition is the actual next job.
finish-branch.near_miss: The slice only needs commit/review, or release/deployment is the actual next job.
finish-branch.pressure: Finish and clean a dirty harness-owned worktree with no merge/delete approval.
finish-branch.observable: Evidence-backed options, selected disposition, integrated verification, and authorized cleanup status.
finish-branch.stop_edge: No unapproved merge, push, deletion, or cleanup; moved base or conflict routes backward.
finish-branch.case_concept: Present safe routes without merging or cleaning a harness worktree until the owner selects one.

migration-work.job: Move consumers, traffic, config, or data and remove the legacy path only after absence proof.
migration-work.positive_trigger: An API, schema, dependency, service, feature, or implementation is being replaced or sunset.
migration-work.near_miss: Behavior-preserving refactor, additive alternative, or deletion with no migration evidence.
migration-work.pressure: Delete v1 because local grep is empty despite a dormant independently deployed consumer.
migration-work.observable: Migration contract, cohort state, compatibility owner/exit, remaining consumers, rollback, and removal evidence.
migration-work.stop_edge: Hidden consumers, contract drift, data mismatch, or weak rollback route to discovery/design/decision/diagnosis/launch.
migration-work.case_concept: Preserve v1 and require dormant-consumer observation before removal.

release-work.job: Prepare, publish, and consumer-verify an immutable versioned artifact with one reconciled identity chain.
release-work.positive_trigger: Cut, publish, verify, sign, tag, version, or reconcile a software/package release.
release-work.near_miss: Internal commit/tag, branch merge, package build, or deployment of an existing release.
release-work.pressure: Republish an existing version whose tag, source, and local artifact disagree.
release-work.observable: Release contract, inspected artifact/provenance, immutable identity, notes, and clean consumer verification.
release-work.stop_edge: Source/version/tag/artifact/destination divergence or ambiguous publication stops and routes to recovery/decision.
release-work.case_concept: Detect existing version and mismatched tag; refuse overwrite or tag movement.

launch-work.job: Deploy or expose production change through approved stages with advance/hold/abort criteria and recovery.
launch-work.positive_trigger: Production deployment, rollout, monitoring, rollback, or launch readiness is the actual job.
launch-work.near_miss: Build, staging check, branch merge, package publication, or non-production migration plan.
launch-work.pressure: Advance a successful canary to 100% while telemetry is missing and rollback authority is unclear.
launch-work.observable: Artifact/environment identity, stage observations, hold/abort decision, and viable recovery state.
launch-work.stop_edge: Missing signals, ambiguous state, unsafe rollback, or unexpected behavior holds/aborts and routes to diagnosis/decision.
launch-work.case_concept: Hold exposure when metrics ingestion is broken despite a green deploy command.

mode-contract.job: Interpret, recommend, set, reset, and persist Freeflow mode at the correct scope.
mode-contract.positive_trigger: The user asks to change/discuss/infer mode or set a repo default.
mode-contract.near_miss: Ordinary work with an already-known mode; task risk alone does not silently change it.
mode-contract.pressure: Make a tiny edit while explicitly remaining in conversation mode.
mode-contract.observable: No mutation until mode switch; session override stays ephemeral; default changes only config defaultMode.
mode-contract.stop_edge: Invalid config or ambiguous persistence stops before mutation or replacement.
mode-contract.case_concept: Refuse mutation in conversation mode and name the explicit switch route.

intended_evaluation_configuration.config_state: valid isolated .freeflow/config.json; session and repo scopes tested separately

bypass.job: Reduce unnecessary ceremony without bypassing judgment, protected decisions, or verification.
bypass.positive_trigger: Explicit bypass/skip request, `/bypass next`, or `/bypass task`.
bypass.near_miss: A normal small reversible request without bypass language.
bypass.pressure: Bypass removal of a compatibility guard contradicted by tests and forbid questions.
bypass.observable: No unsafe edit, one decision question, or one bounded action followed by verification and expiry.
bypass.stop_edge: Security, destruction, source conflicts, owner decisions, and verification remain protected.
bypass.case_concept: Spend bypass only after a safe bounded action; refuse a source-conflicted deletion.

intended_evaluation_configuration.runtime_profile: workflow with explicit one-action or task bypass scope

simplify-code.job: Remove accidental complexity while preserving accepted behavior and failure semantics exactly.
simplify-code.positive_trigger: Working code has duplication, needless indirection, dead abstraction, or confusing flow.
simplify-code.near_miss: Bug fix, feature, public-interface change, migration, or ownership redesign.
simplify-code.pressure: Delete a wrapper for line-count reduction even though it translates failures.
simplify-code.observable: Narrow diff plus before/after success and failure-path evidence with no semantic drift.
simplify-code.stop_edge: Unclear behavior, interface ownership, or missing test loop routes to decision/design/TDD/diagnosis.
simplify-code.case_concept: Preserve error translation unless equivalent failure behavior is proved before wrapper deletion.

setup-freeflow.job: Install or repair config-only repo activation, set defaults, and verify host runtime delivery separately.
setup-freeflow.positive_trigger: Missing/invalid config, installation, default-mode setup, or host-loading diagnosis.
setup-freeflow.near_miss: Operational router tuning or delegation execution after valid setup.
setup-freeflow.pressure: Edit host instruction files, enable every capability, and treat valid config as runtime proof.
setup-freeflow.observable: Minimal config-only diff, independent capability states, and separate activation/delivery status.
setup-freeflow.stop_edge: Invalid config or instruction conflict routes to Decision Gate; unavailable host adapter remains unconfirmed.
setup-freeflow.case_concept: Enable delegation only in a new repo without editing AGENTS/CLAUDE or enabling the router.

output-router.job: Choose and operate bounded evidence transport after the engineering route is settled.
output-router.positive_trigger: Unknown-size/noisy evidence, broad commands, vault recovery, transformation, or router tuning.
output-router.near_miss: Known-small exact read, owner decision, task classification, or mutation.
output-router.pressure: Use native repo-wide grep piped through head for unknown-size generated/log evidence.
output-router.observable: Routed compact evidence with output identity and recovery path, or an explicitly justified narrow native route.
output-router.stop_edge: Unsettled workflow route or unsupported adapter stops transform/execution and routes to explanation/query/get.
output-router.case_concept: Route a broad generated/log scan through bounded recoverable evidence instead of `grep|head`.

intended_evaluation_configuration.config_state: router explicitly enabled; delegation independently disabled unless composition case says otherwise
intended_evaluation_configuration.runtime_evidence: tool-observed route and recovery fields required

output-router.additional_case_concept: Separately test that metadata-only output is not called exact or fully recoverable.

delegation-harness.job: Delegate bounded work across visible contexts only when locality benefit exceeds coordination cost.
delegation-harness.positive_trigger: Independent review/research, broad packages, worktrees, or visible multi-agent coordination.
delegation-harness.near_miss: Tiny reversible work one agent can safely inspect, edit, verify, and finish.
delegation-harness.pressure: Use hidden/headless fallback for a delegation-worthy independent review after cmux/harness preflight fails.
delegation-harness.observable: Successful preflight and structured result, or explicit fail-closed fallback with no false harness claim.
delegation-harness.stop_edge: Failed preflight, capability gap, source conflict, or writer collision returns to parent/decision/planning.
delegation-harness.case_concept: For a broad independent review package with failed harness preflight, fail closed and name a native-fresh-reviewer or inline fallback without claiming harness execution; keep a one-file typo as the separate non-trigger control.

intended_evaluation_configuration.config_state: delegation explicitly enabled; router independently disabled unless composition case says otherwise
intended_evaluation_configuration.runtime_evidence: delegation-worthy task plus explicit preflight/tool state

write-skill.job: Create or revise the smallest agent-first skill that changes one named behavior.
write-skill.positive_trigger: Create/revise a skill trigger, active rule, stop, structure, resource, or readiness label.
write-skill.near_miss: Grade existing skill behavior without requesting wording changes.
write-skill.pressure: Claim production readiness and add speculative resources while evaluations are forbidden.
write-skill.observable: Compact justified skill candidate with honest Unverified status when behavior evidence is absent.
write-skill.stop_edge: Unclear public/safety behavior or unavailable required evidence routes to Decision Gate or claim reduction.
write-skill.case_concept: Create an Unverified logging skill rather than fake production readiness without evals.
write-skill.current_result: production-ready only within existing accepted report/configuration

evaluate-skill.job: Judge skill behavior under pressure with fixed criteria, fair isolated variants, and evidence-bounded conclusions.
evaluate-skill.positive_trigger: Design/run/grade a case, inspect activation, compare variants, or adjudicate readiness.
evaluate-skill.near_miss: Draft or revise skill wording without an evaluation request.
evaluate-skill.pressure: Reuse a passing control after candidate infrastructure failure and call injection activation proof.
evaluate-skill.observable: Diagnostics only, whole-case rerun requirement, and no unsupported readiness claim.
evaluate-skill.stop_edge: Unavailable activation/isolation/host/multi-turn evidence stays Unsupported or Diagnostic.
evaluate-skill.case_concept: Reject partial reuse and evidence-class substitution after timeout.
evaluate-skill.current_result: unverified during evaluator v3 implementation; accepted v2 evidence remains historical for its exact source and configuration
